messages:
Harpreet (finance): Quick company announcement: starting Feb 1 were consolidating vendor master records and shifting to a bi-weekly vendor payout cadence (Tues/Wed). This is to reduce payment churn and enable early-pay discount negotiations. Please read and action if you own vendor relationships. Link: https://docs.redwood.internal/vendor-master-2026 :loudspeaker:
Diego (procurement): Important ops notes: 1) All vendors must have a single canonical vendor_name and tax_id in the intake sheet. 2) New invoices should include the canonical vendor ID (column on the sheet) to avoid duplicate records. 3) Well only process invoices with valid vendor IDs after Jan 25.
Zara (accounts payable): AP will switch to bi-weekly runs on Feb 2 (first run covers invoices received by Jan 29). If you need an exception for a critical vendor, file a ticket in #help-finance and tag @Zara with 'expedite' and rationale.
Toby (engineering): For contractor payouts that go through vendor flows, will this affect SOW vendors that invoice monthly?
Harpreet (finance): SOW vendors remain eligible for the bi-weekly runs. Just ensure their invoices include the canonical vendor ID and the cost_center tag. Multi-line invoices should have the CSV summary attached.
Lola (sales): Any change to virtual card policy? We use vCards for trial subscriptions and partner reimbursements.
Diego (procurement): No change to vCard eligibility in this announcement. One ask: for recurring vCard subscriptions, convert to a vendor record where possible. vCards create reconciliation overhead.
payments-bot: Scheduled notice: vendor-master.csv import completed at 03:00 UTC, 1,128 records matched, 42 duplicates flagged. :gear:
Harpreet (finance): New requirement: teams seeking early-pay discounts should add 'early_pay_candidate: yes' in the intake notes. Procurement will prioritize negotiating those and AP will route offers to payments@redwood.com. Typical negotiation window is 2-4 weeks.
Zara (accounts payable): Invoice cutoff rules: invoices must be submitted as PDF/CSV and reference a PO or canonical vendor ID. Invoices missing required fields will be rejected and emailed back to submitter with a rejection code. Example rejection code payload:

```
REJECT: MISSING_VENDOR_ID; please supply canonical_vendor_id column from vendor-master.csv
```

Diego (procurement): Consolidation tip: if you maintain vendor lists across multiple sheets, run this simple dedupe command locally before uploading:

```
# dedupe example (csvkit)
csvcut -c canonical_vendor_id,vendor_name all_vendors.csv | csvsort -c canonical_vendor_id | uniq
```

Toby (engineering): Will procurement publish a mapping JSON so we can auto-tag billing exports?
Diego (procurement): Yes, well publish a stable CSV and a small JSON mapping by Jan 22. For now, use the vendor-master sheet and the canonical_vendor_id column.
Harpreet (finance): Action items: owners, please verify your team's vendors in the vendor-master sheet by Jan 25; attach canonical_vendor_id to any open invoices; tag early-pay candidates. We'll send a follow-up FAQ later today. Questions?
Lola (sales): Copy that 1. Will push updates to our deals ops sheet today.
Toby (engineering): Pushing a script to align our billing export with the vendor_master CSV. Will notify when done.
Zara (accounts payable): Reminder: any payment disputes after the switch should be filed within 10 business days to avoid holdbacks.
Harpreet (finance): Thanks everyone 4b8. If you hit blockers, post in #help-finance with vendor IDs and I'll triage.
